title: Project Management for Instructional Designers
description: Project Management for Instructional Designers (PM4ID) is a textbook about project management tailored specifically for instructional designers, intended for use in graduate programs in educational technology. This book is based on a pre-existing openly licensed textbook which was donated to the commons by a benefactor that desires to remain anonymous, and has been collaboratively revised and remixed by faculty and students at Brigham Young University.
authors: Bobbie Sandberg - Author / Royce Kimmons - Author / Rebecca Zundel - Author
